Description: Project foundation Docker setup security hardening and automated testing.
Fragrance catalogue management olfactory search and product browsing.
Shopping bag checkout flow coupon system and Stripe payment integration.
Order history custom admin dashboard reviews and responsive UI.

As a developer/examiner, I want to start the full application and PostgreSQL database with one command (docker compose up --build) so that evaluation is reproducible and zero-friction.

Acceptance Criteria:
- docker-compose.yml orchestrating web and postgres:16-alpine with healthcheck.
- Multi-stage Dockerfile with Python 3.11-slim.
- .env.example and automatic database migrations via entrypoint.sh.

Summary: GRX-13 · Security Hardening: Argon2 CSRF & Security Headers
Description:
As the security engineer, I want the system hardened against common web vulnerabilities.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Argon2 password hashing as primary hasher.
- Strict CSRF protection on forms and state-changing endpoints.
- XSS, clickjacking, and session protection headers configured.

Summary: GRX-15 · Automated pytest Suite: Concurrency Stress & Webhook Tests
Description:
As a quality engineer, I want automated tests running via pytest to guarantee reliability across catalog, auth, cart, payments, and concurrent stock transactions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Pytest tests covering auth, catalog, cart, webhook, and multi-threaded concurrency locking.

As an online shopper, I want to register and sign in securely with my email and password so my shipping addresses and fragrance orders are saved.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Custom User model with email login and Argon2 password hashing.
- Profile editing for Romanian delivery addresses.

Summary: GRX-03 · Curated Fragrance Catalogue: 32 Luxury Perfumes
Description:
As a fragrance lover, I want to browse perfumes organized by category (Women, Men, Unisex, Gift sets) and scent family, inspect the 3-tier olfactory pyramid (Top, Heart, Base notes), and pick bottle sizes.

Acceptance Criteria:
- 30+ curated luxury & niche fragrances in seed script.
- ProductVariant model storing size in ml, price in RON, SKU, and independent inventory stock.

Summary: GRX-04 · Olfactory Search & Faceted Family Filtering
Description:
As a shopper, I want to search fragrances by title, brand, note (e.g. Saffron, Amber, Bergamot), and filter by fragrance family so I can find scents matching my taste.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Multi-field Q search query across title, brand, description, and notes.

Summary: GRX-05 · Shopping Bag & Complimentary Discovery Samples
Description:
As a customer, I want to add items to my cart, adjust quantities up to available stock, and pick 2 free discovery vials.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Session cart calculation with free delivery threshold (300 RON).
- Choice of up to 2 complimentary fragrance samples.

As a shopper, I want to apply discount codes (e.g., WELCOME10, LUXURY20) and have them validated strictly on the server.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Server-side percentage discounts calculated before taxes & shipping.

Summary: GRX-07 · Multi-Step Checkout Flow with Romanian Address Validation
Description:
As a customer, I want to review my shipping details and order breakdown before being redirected to payment.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Form validation for Romanian addresses and contact details.
- Atomic pending order creation.

As a store owner, I want to guarantee that two simultaneous shoppers cannot buy the last unit of a fragrance at the same time.

Acceptance Criteria:
- create_order_from_cart uses select_for_update() inside transaction.atomic().
- Automated concurrency unit test simulating parallel checkouts.

Summary: GRX-09 · Stripe Test Mode & Async Webhook Confirmation
Description:
As a customer, I want to pay securely via Stripe, and as a store owner, orders must become PAID only when the asynchronous webhook confirms the payment.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Stripe Checkout Session creation with line items in RON.
- Webhook endpoint handling checkout.session.completed with signature validation.
- Interactive Sandbox testing mode with local simulator.

Summary: GRX-10 · Customer Order History & Delivery Status Tracking
Description:
As a customer, I want an order history page to track status (Pending, Paid, Shipped, Delivered) and view past purchase receipts.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Authenticated customer portal listing past orders with item snapshots and status badges.

Summary: GRX-11 · Custom Administration Command Center (KPI Dashboard)
Description:
As store administrators, we want a custom-built dashboard (not default Django admin) to monitor revenue KPIs, manage perfumes and bottle sizes, restock low inventory, and update order statuses.

Acceptance Criteria:
- KPI overview: gross revenue, order volume, low-stock alerts, customer count.
- Full CRUD for products, size variants, and prices.
- Order status workflow management and quick inventory replenishment.

Summary: GRX-12 · Verified Buyer Fragrance Reviews & Star Ratings
Description:
As a shopper, I want authentic reviews written only by customers who actually bought the fragrance.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Review submission gated to users who have a confirmed paid order for that specific product.

Summary: GRX-14 · Responsive Luxury UI in Tailwind CSS (Mobile to 4K)
Description:
As a mobile customer, I want the perfumery website to look elegant, luxurious, and render flawlessly on 360px mobile screens as well as 4K monitors.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Dark obsidian, warm gold, and creamy ivory palette.
- Mobile responsive drawer, filters, and cards.
